item.title:
Here's a possible translation of the headline:
"פרו רוממה בנשיאה החדש ואחריות אחרונה מלטינ-אמריקה, קריביאן"
Note: I've used the Hebrew word "רוממה" (rummah) which means to take an oath or swear in, and also included the phrase "אחריות אחרונה" (acharot achronah), which means "other top photos", to convey the idea of a collection of images.
Alternatively, you could use:
"פרו רוממה בנשיאה החדש, ואחריות"
Which translates to "Peru swears in new president, and other news".
